title: Grateful Dead Live at Pirates World on 1970-03-24
lineage: SBD > MR > Cass > DAT > Cass > DAT > ZA2 > CD Wave > SHN

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard capture with a stellar 1970 set featuring Dark Star, Good Lovin', High Time and an inspired Lovelight‑Me and My Uncle segue.
ai_review.review: The recording is a surprisingly clean sound‑board source despite an odd channel split that puts most instruments on one side and vocals on the other. Musically the show shines – Dark Star, Good Lovin', High Time, The Other One and a magical Lovelight → Me and My Uncle transition are repeatedly praised, with Bob Weir’s lead work highlighted on several jams.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive commentary on both performance and recording; detailed fan praise across >8 reviews with only minor technical quibbles.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clean and listenable, but the mix is unconventional – most instruments on one channel, vocals isolated on the other, giving a slightly unbalanced stereo image.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A rich, exploratory set with strong segues (e.g., Lovelight into Me and My Uncle) and a high‑energy second half; the only drawback noted is the truncated opening Dew.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for soulful playing on Dark Star, High Time and overall show energy.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for standout jams on Good Lovin' and a beautiful rendition of Cold Rain & Snow.
band_member_comments.Drums: Described as jazzy and driving, especially in the Dark Star and St. Stephen sections.
